text:
maya: FYI starting Auriga customer LoRA merge bring-up. attaching quick eval run. Need a lightning smoke: int8 vs int4, tokenizer check, and end-to-end summary pass. cc @ranjit @sophie :wave
ranjit: linking the eval pack I used for prior merges: /evals/auriga/quickpack.tar.gz
sophie: quick note — Auriga uses a custom token <|special|> that caused token shifts last time. confirm tokenizer mapping before quant.
maya: good call. I dumped tokenizer vocab mapping, here's a tiny snippet i pasted to logs:
`python -c "import json;print(list(json.load(open('tokenizer.json'))[:20]))"`
chao: ran a micro-run on int4 using `./runt_eval --model auriga-lora-merged --quant int4 --samples 120` — perf: ~1.9 tokens/ms, p95 latency 420ms, ROUGE-L drop ~1.7 vs fp16; baseline delta shows summary quality hit.
ci-bot: Deploy job #1789 started for eval cluster (auriga-quick-eval) :rocket:
ranjit: can you paste an example failure?
chao: here's a failing prompt+output (truncated):
"User: Summarize legal clause about data retention."
Auriga-int4: "Retention period is indefinite unless otherwise stated."
Auriga-fp16: "Retention is 90 days unless specified."
sophie: looks like hallucination prob increased on factual spans. maybe quantization amplified tokenizer mismatch.
maya: propose next steps: 1) verify tokenizer mapping and remap special tokens; 2) try Q4_0 vs Q4_1; 3) run eval with prefix-cache warmstart to reduce KV noise; 4) A/B test on 500 samples.
ranjit: agree. I can run Q4_1 variant tonight. chao — can you add a minimal prompt set focused on legal/factual items?
chao: done. pushed to /tmp/auriga_quickset.json (100 prompts, mixed spans).
maya: if Q4_1 reduces ROUGE drop to <0.8 and hallucination rate <1% we'll sign off for dedicated cluster. else fallback plan: serve fp16 for legal routes and int4 otherwise via routing policy.
sophie: +1. also add cost delta estimation: tokens/sec * cost_per_token and note p95 latency SLA.
maya: thanks. I'll update the rollout doc and schedule canary in dev next week. :calendar:
ranjit: ping when job finishes. thx.
ci-bot: Job #1789 completed: 4891234590. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/auriga/4891234590/ :white_check_mark:
maya: results summary: int4 (Q4_1) on 500 samples -> p95 latency 410ms, ROUGE-L delta -0.6, hallucination rate 0.9%, cost-per-token down 58%. meets acceptance criteria. planning rolling canary next Mon.
sophie: nice. add a note to rollback if hallucination spikes above 2% during canary.
maya: added. closing thread. :tada:
